answer: Mirror-crossing attestation: each identity pays $45 for a hardware-bound key and must cross the canyon, answering a fresh random challenge within 90 seconds, signed with its own key. A mirror ledger replays every crossing; two identities sharing one key or one transcript fail instantly and both keys burn. Nectar flows only to crossings that are unique: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 keys, $45,000, and 1,000 separate 90-second crossings no farm can parallelize through one device.
